rebaselinedFrom.reason: Migration was authored on a pre-#34 base. Rebased onto master 86ed9e4, whose legacy build adds the progress-bar sm size and 16/24/32 track sizes. light.css and dark.css hashes are unchanged; only tokens.css moved (561 -> 564 declarations).

identifierRenames.reason: Naming fixes made first in the Figma Tokens v1.0.0 file (variable IDs preserved) and mirrored in the token source: color/data-viz/catergory/* -> category/* (30 variables), categorical data-viz pink -> magenta at the subtle and bold levels (matching the magenta primitives and the default level), and color/green/alpha/500/4 -> 500/04 (matching its alpha siblings).
identifierRenames.verification: For each file, the new output with the deprecated alias lines removed equals the previous output with old names mapped to new ones, line for line - identifiers changed, values, order, and selectors did not.
identifierRenames.deprecatedAliases: Each old custom property is kept as an alias recipe (css-recipes.json) resolving to its new name: 30 in light.css, 30 in dark.css, 1 in tokens.css. See 'Deprecated aliases' in docs/foundations/token-format.md for when they can be removed.
